slides.headline: Coffee Convenience. Interest-Free Corporate Funding.
slides.subheadline: Prepaid coffee funds Starbucks before your next order arrives.

production.sharedRules: Apply this palette throughout. Use 64px condensed headlines, readable editorial body typography, monospace kickers with square indicators, and tabular numerals. Corners are 0px or 2px; borders are 1px ink hairlines. No shadows, pills, thick accent borders, progress bars, or simulated text. Production metadata and SVG instructions are not displayed. Render citation markers as compact source references. Add no unprovided display copy.

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 952 650" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Reserve approximately half the canvas for a monumental sectional sculpture: a Starbucks stored-value card tipped toward an industrial cash reservoir, with an empty coffee cup below a closed outlet. Build 28 identifiable elements: chamfered card perimeter, inset perimeter, magnetic stripe, stripe highlight, four registration notches, reservoir shell, upper ellipse, lower ellipse, liquid surface, orange liquid body, sight glass, six graduation ticks, inlet lip, three falling orange payment slivers, outlet stem, valve wheel, cup rim, and tapered cup body. Payment slivers enter the reservoir while nothing reaches the cup. The reservoir is a timing metaphor, not a claimed segregated reserve; use no quantitative fill scale. Do not invent an EMV chip on the Starbucks card. Place the 64px headline above a hairline; finish with a quiet publication ledger.

slides.headline: Convenience Makes Prepayment Feel Effortless
slides.subheadline: The customer benefits are real, not imaginary.

items.title: DAILY DRAW
items.body: Enjoy **convenience, rewards and nonexpiring card balances**.

items.title: FEE PROMISE
items.body: No **activation, service, dormancy or inactivity fees**.

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 952 420" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Position a broad Surface hero panel at left and a smaller Paper ledger panel lower-right, both with 1px borders and square corners. Integrate an enlarged stored-value card behind the first item's typography and a thermal receipt silhouette behind the second. Use 26 structural elements: chamfered card outline, inset edge, magnetic stripe, four corner registration marks, two card-edge glints, receipt perimeter, eight serrated teeth, two feed rollers, roller axle, paper curl, and four optical registration marks. Add one genuine Code 128 barcode encoding TFP, generated with valid start, checksum, and stop symbols; treat it as an editorial specimen, never a usable payment credential. No fake receipt text. Keep all anatomy peripheral to the two short copy blocks.

slides.headline: Those Billions Aren’t Bank Deposits
slides.subheadline: Two reported liabilities measure more than gift-card cash.​

items.title: CARD/LOYALTY LIABILITY
items.body: Includes **loyalty obligations**, not just purchased balances.

items.title: BROADER CURRENT LIABILITY
items.body: Includes **$177.0 million** Nestlé prepaid-royalty deferred revenue.

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 448 370" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Use a 40/60 split: a sectional financial specimen at left and two compact, hairline-bordered numerical ledgers at right. Draw a disassembled accounting instrument rather than two cash tanks. Its 25 elements comprise a chamfered stored-value card, inset edge, magnetic stripe, five-point loyalty star, star registration ring, royalty-document contour, folded corner, embossed circular seal, three alignment pins, balance-beam arm, fulcrum, two suspension rods, two shallow weighing pans, four fasteners, baseline, and four measurement ticks. Accent the star and document seal to expose obligations beyond purchased balances. Do not size specimens proportionally, add the two reported liabilities, or imply one is a fully nested subset of the other. Align exact metrics on their decimal points.

slides.headline: Forgotten Money Becomes Reported Revenue
slides.subheadline: Nonexpiration and breakage can coexist without contradiction.​

items.title: ESTIMATE NONREDEMPTION
items.body: Historical patterns estimate **what customers won’t redeem**.

items.title: RECOGNIZE PROPORTIONATELY
items.body: **Recognize breakage proportionately** as customers redeem balances.

items.title: RESPECT CLAIMS
items.body: Account for **applicable unclaimed-property remittances** when estimating.

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 952 480" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Run one continuous 1px vertical spine through three square milestone markers. Place each compact title and finding beside its marker, never inside a card. Opposite the copy, develop three connected views of one receipt-accounting instrument. Use 27 elements: receipt outline, six serrated teeth, two feed rollers, axle, two bearing rings, three square milestone markers, spine, proportional recognition dial, dial needle, four radial ticks, stored-value card perimeter, magnetic stripe, remittance-document contour, folded corner, and circular seal. Orange appears only on the recognition needle and milestone markers. Keep the card contour intact through all stages: accounting recognition must not visually erase a customer's balance. No invented percentages or simulated text.

slides.headline: Breakage Is Revenue, Not Profit
slides.subheadline: Recognition brings no new cash into Starbucks.
slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 952 440" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Set $222.4 in 110px accent tabular numerals, with million and the uppercase mono revenue label directly beneath. Present the two disclosed components as a single open addition ledger below, not cards; the hero is their calculated sum. Behind the ledger, construct a thermal audit receipt emerging from a cutaway register. Use 25 structural elements: register upper shell, lower shell, paper slot, two feed rollers, axle, two bearing rings, receipt perimeter, eight serrated teeth, two mounting screws, two dimension endpoints, dimension rule, and two calculation alignment marks. Include a genuine Code 128 barcode encoding TFP2025, with checksum and quiet zones. Do not depict fresh money entering the receipt, a profit margin, or a quantitative reservoir level.

slides.headline: Starbucks Gets Your Money First
slides.subheadline: Payment arrives before Starbucks fulfills your purchase.

items.title: FUNDING ADVANTAGE
items.body: Starbucks receives **prepayment without paying you interest**.

items.title: REFUND GATE
items.body: **Refunds restricted**; law or agreement can permit.

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 952 420" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Build two horizontal timing tracks, not progress bars. The upper track carries a stored-value card toward a solid corporate receipt endpoint; the lower track has an open dashed cash-refund gate. Place the supplied terms date on a square-ended mono plate. Use 28 elements: two timing rails, two solid endpoints, four dashed gate segments, card perimeter, inset card edge, magnetic stripe, reservoir shell, upper ellipse, lower ellipse, sight glass, four graduation ticks, valve stem, valve wheel, empty cup rim, tapered cup body, cash-note contour, two note rosettes, and two dimension endpoints. Accent the completed prepayment endpoint; leave the refund gate conditional, not permanently locked. Avoid fabricated elapsed times, automatic-refund promises, or reserve-coverage implications.

slides.headline: Retail Funding, Not Unregulated Banking
slides.subheadline: Uninsured does not mean stripped of gift-card protections.​

items.title: DEPOSIT MYTH
items.body: Your prepayment **is not a bank deposit**.

slides.footer: Starbucks balances never expire. No FDIC insurance.
slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 448 370" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Reverse slide 3's composition: use a 60/40 split with open, unboxed verdict typography at left and a dominant comparison engraving at right. No ledger cards. Draw an intact stored-value card in the foreground, separated by an orange architectural cut from a distant bank-vault elevation. Use 28 elements: card perimeter, inset edge, magnetic stripe, four registration notches, vault outer ring, inner ring, combination dial, dial pointer, eight radial ticks, four locking lugs, two hinges, separation cut, and two dimension endpoints. Keep the card intact and the vault neutral; do not use a broken shield, disappearing balance, or government guarantee symbol. The separation distinguishes retail prepayment from insured banking without depicting the product as lawless.
